messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: Problem when deploying: Error in if (!(repository %in% c("CRAN", "GitHub", "BioC")))
parts:
Hi

I just tried shinyapps for the first time, and when trying to deploy a very simple app, that loads no other packages than shiny, I got following error message:

Erreur dans if (!(repository %in% c("CRAN", "GitHub", "BioC"))) { :
  l'argument est de longueur nulle

This seems to come from validateRepository() function? When looking at the code (which I took from: https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/blob/master/R/bundle.R) , I notice the lines:

if (!(repository %in% c("CRAN", "GitHub", "BioC")))
....
if (is.null(repository))

Which strikes me a little bit... the code seems to check whether 'repository' is null (second condition), yet if it is null, won't it fail the first condition with the same error message I got. Should the second check not be done first?

Or am I going the wrong route, and my initial error message comes from something else? Here is my sessionInfo() (without locale)

Thanks a lot!

Matthieu

messages.subject: Re: Problem when deploying: Error in if (!(repository %in% c("CRAN", "GitHub", "BioC")))
parts:
great, fixed now indeed, thanks!

But this led me to a second, distinct errror (maybe I should open a second thread?), that it complained that the "The package was installed locally from source". I am indeed under Linux, using the r-cran-* packaging system, so that CRAN packages are installed with the apt-get package system instead of from within R...

Are there important issues to be foreseen if the apps is using a CRAN package installed locally? It would be great if there would be an option to force shinyapps to consider as "CRAN" a r-cran-* package (maybe provided they are same version, etc?) ? But maybe there are some aspects I miss...

Thanks a lot!!

Matthieu

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Problem when deploying: Error in if (!(repository %in% c("CRAN", "GitHub", "BioC")))
parts:
You raised two excellent questions, and they are related to my
proposal to our team yesterday:
https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps-package-dependencies/issues/4

I'm all for supporting r-cran-* packages, which will be easier and
much faster to install than compiling R source packages, when the
version from apt-get is the same as the one on CRAN. I totally agree
there is room for improvement here. I think the ultimate solution is
to provide an alternative to the current automatic dependency
detection, which does not always work. One possibility is to specify
the dependencies in the DESCRIPTION file of the app, e.g.

Depends: ggplot2 (>= 0.9.2), rgl, MASS
DependsDebian: r-cran-xml, r-cran-rcurl

I have Cc'ed a few team members.

Regards,
Yihui

Dear Yihui

Thanks for your detailed answer!

I am glad you concurred on that point, and agree with you that using the
r-cran-* system might be good internally also! As allowing for CRAN
packages installed under r-cran* is slightly different (though related)
issue, I opened a new issue on github, hoping this will raise interest
among the developers.
https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps-package-dependencies/issues/5

Thanks a lot for your work!!

Matthieu
